title: Real-Time sky radiance filter on the Mobile renderer is broken after 4.7
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.8.dev https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/eb066bbdf37a72e0a71255766bd9728954038e4d - Not reproducible in: 4.7.stable ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (eb066bbdf) - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 595.80) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description Real-Time sky radiance filter on the Mobile renderer is broken after 4.7: `master` | 4.7.stable | High Quality (for comparison) -|-|- | | This is also printed on startup: ``` ERROR: Uniforms supplied for set (2): Set: 2 Binding: 0 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: R16G16B16A16_Sfloat Set: 2 Binding: 1 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: R16G16B16A16_Sfloat Set: 2 Binding: 2 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: R16G16B16A16_Sfloat Set: 2 Binding: 3 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: R16G16B16A16_Sfloat Set: 2 Binding: 4 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: R16G16B16A16_Sfloat Set: 2 Binding: 5 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: R16G16B16A16_Sfloat are not the same format as required by the pipeline shader. Pipeline shader requires the following bindings: Set: 0 Binding: 0 Type: CombinedSampler Writable: N Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Set: 1 Binding: 0 Type: StorageBuffer Writable: N Length: 0 Set: 2 Binding: 0 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: A2B10G10R10_Unorm_Pack32 Set: 2 Binding: 1 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: A2B10G10R10_Unorm_Pack32 Set: 2 Binding: 2 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: A2B10G10R10_Unorm_Pack32 Set: 2 Binding: 3 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: A2B10G10R10_Unorm_Pack32 Set: 2 Binding: 4 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: A2B10G10R10_Unorm_Pack32 Set: 2 Binding: 5 Type: Image Writable: Y Length: 1 Texture Type: 2D Texture Format: A2B10G10R10_Unorm_Pack32 at: compute_list_dispatch (./servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:6849) ``` I bisected the regression to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120902. cc @blueskythlikesclouds ### Steps to reproduce - On the Mobile renderer, switch to the Real-Time sky filter mode in the Environment's Sky resource. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [test_pr_107958.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29901370/test_pr_107958.zip) Press Enter to toggle between real-time and high quality sky update modes (with real-time being the default).
